text:
QUOTE: "Option A, compile time (no runtime pointer, no setter)" and "Option B, runtime (only `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` defined)" with "In this mode `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free` is not declared, so calling it is a compile error."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer separates the compile-time macro pair (CALLOC_MACRO/FREE_MACRO) from the runtime function-pointer setter and states the setter isn't compiled when the macros are defined, so the two are mutually exclusive.
